articles.title: Joly, Stellantis officials set for latest showdown on Friday
articles.summary: Industry Minister Mélanie Joly is set to meet with representatives of Stellantis, the Ontario government and Unifor again today behind closed doors. The sit-down comes as Joly says the automaker can either keep its Brampton, Ont. plant open rather than selling it to defence contractor Roshel, or face a multimillion-dollar lawsuit from the federal government. articles.title: Ford Super Duty pickup trucks begin rolling out after retool at Oakville, Ont., plant
articles.summary: The plant is reopened and trucks are already rolling out. Now, Ford Motor Co. hopes its Oakville, Ont., assembly complex can help it drive growth and demonstrate the automaker’s commitment to Canadian manufacturing for the long haul. Friday marks the official relaunch of the site following a major transformation to prepare for production of the […]

articles.title: 2 Clarington men arrested for alleged theft from Ajax construction site
articles.summary: Durham Regional Police have arrested two men from Clarington in connection with a theft at an Ajax construction site that occurred on Nov. 12. Police were called to the site in the area of Harwood Avenue South and Clements Road West and launched an investigation. Investigators executed a search warrant on Thursday at a residence […]

articles.title: Teen charged after vehicle explosion at Ajax GO Station parking garage
articles.summary: A 17-year-old Oshawa male is facing several charges after a vehicle exploded and caught fire at the Ajax GO Station parking garage late Thursday night. articles.title: Streetcar diverting, traffic down to one lane for major infrastructure work on King Street West until winter 2027
articles.summary: King Street West will be undergoing major infrastructure work over the next year, causing interruptions for drivers and TTC riders. Starting Monday and continuing through until winter 2027, the TTC and the City of Toronto will be replacing aging watermain infrastructure and renewing streetcar tracks. The construction will start between Dufferin Street and Close Avenue […]

articles.title: 60-year-old driver charged after crash that killed pedestrian in August: Durham police
articles.summary: On Aug. 18, officers responded after a man on rollerblades was struck by a transport truck driven by a 60-year-old man in Ajax, Ont., Durham police said. Three months later, the driver has been charged with careless driving causing death.

articles.title: Transport truck driver charged in collision that killed man rollerblading in Ajax
articles.summary: The Durham Regional Police Service (DRPS) have charged a 60-year-old man after a pedestrian who was rollerblading was struck and killed in a collision in Ajax over the summer. articles.title: Fuel truck crash, fire closes Highway 401 eastbound near Trenton
articles.summary: Ontario Provincial Police say a fuel truck crashed and caught fire near Highway 401's Wooler Road interchange Friday morning. There were closures on the 401 and County Road 40 until around 9:30 a.m.

articles.title: Peel Region's new council chair on the 'tumultuous new world' of strong regional chairs
articles.summary: Peel Region's new provincially appointed council chair said he recognizes the "tumultuous" circumstances that led to his appointment, during his first message to council on inauguration day.

articles.title: Man dead after being struck by vehicle in Mississauga, police say
articles.summary: A man is dead after being struck by a vehicle in Mississauga on Thursday evening, police say.

articles.title: Vehicle ticketed in Toronto minutes after rush hour sign change — and driver is not happy
articles.summary: A Toronto resident is speaking out after he received a $120 parking ticket in Parkdale minutes after crews took down old traffic signs and put up new ones that changed the no-stopping times on a stretch of Queen Street W. Police say they will request tickets issued during the sign change be cancelled.

articles.title: SIU charges Halton police officer after shooting of Burlington, Ont., man in motel parking lot
articles.summary: A Halton police officer has been charged, according to the Ontario police watchdog, after shooting a 23-year-old man multiple times.

articles.title: Chow turns down police board seat, selects new committee heads at city hall
articles.summary: Mayor Olivia Chow again turned down a post on the Toronto police board Thursday. She also opted to shake up high-profile committee roles, charging newly elected and veteran allies with key positions.

articles.title: Peel police charge off-duty Sudbury police sergeant and 1 other following altercation in Mississauga
articles.summary: Peel Regional Police say they charged two Sudbury men after an altercation at a hotel in Mississauga on November 7. A spokesperson with Sudbury police confirms one of them is a sergeant with Greater Sudbury Police Service.
